title: The Wise Woman of Abel
reflectionText: While the wall of Abel was battered, one wise woman asked Joab to come near and reminded him that counsel was once asked at Abel. A city and a mother in Israel were spared when her word, not the siege, settled the matter. Where might asking counsel still hold off ruin?
editorialNotes: Packet 027 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 2 Samuel 20:1-22, narrates Amasa’s death with factual restraint, and ends at verse 22 with Joab’s return to Jerusalem.
